page.layout: Two columns of entries separated by a vertical rule, on one printed page. Page number 10 at top left of the left column. Running head in Hebrew at the top of each column.

main_text.p: אוֹיֵב inimicus , ים' inimici , &c. Ben. Kal , sing. & pl. masc. Rad. אָיַב inimicatus est.
אוֹיְתִךְ desidero te , אוֹיְתִיהָ expetivi eam , 1. sing. præt. Piel , aff. Rad. אָוָה.
אוֹכִיחַ arguam , הֹכִיחַ arguam te , &c. 1. sing. fut. Hiph. affix. Rad. יָכַח [?].
אוֹכָל , אוֹכִיל cibus, commeatus , esca , No. f. m. R. אָכַל comedit.
אוֹכֵל comedens , ים' comedentes , &c. Ben. Kal , sing. & pl. m. Rad. אָכַל.
אוֹכַל potero , הָאוֹכַל num potero , 1. sing. fut. Kal, Rad. יָכַל.
אוֹלִיד gignam, 1. sing. fut. Hiph. R. יָלַד.
אוֹלַד nascar , 1. sing. fut. Niph. R. יָלַד.
אוֹלִיךְ, vel הָ אוֹלִיכָה ire faciam , ם deducam
eos, &c. 1. sing. fut. Hiph. affix. & parag. Rad. יָלַךְ.
אוּלָם profecto , certè , verumtamen, part. Adverb. Rad. inusit. אוֹל.
אוּלָם robur eorum, No. sing. m. אוֹל aff. Rad. inusit. אוֹל robur, vel Rad. אָוַל.
אוּלָם porticus, No. sing. masc. R. אָלַם ligare in fasciculum.
אוּלְתִּי stultitia mea, אוּלְתֵּךְ stultitia sua, No. sing. fæm. אוּלַת stultitia, aff. Rad. inusit. אָוַל.
אוֹמֵר dicens , ים' dicentes, &c. Ben. Kal, sing. & pl. m. Rad. אָמַר.
אוֹנָךְ vanitas tua , ם' iniquitas ipsorum , No. sing. masc. אָוֶן iniquitas , aff. Rad. inusit. אוֹן.
אוֹנָם potentia ejus, אוֹנוֹ potentia mea, ים' vires, No. sing.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek letters, vowel points and the sequence of forms are best-effort readings of a small, dense print; the Hebrew in several entries (notably the forms after "vel", "num" and the suffixed forms) is doubtful and should be checked against the scan. The running head letters are unclear. Long s has been written as plain s throughout, as the transcription rules require, so printed f-like forms such as "fua" and "fing." appear as "sua" and "sing.". The page is set in two columns; the right column continues the entry "deducam" from the left column ("eos"). Some reference marks (ים', ם') are read as printed but may be misplaced.
